mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS position_id, p.position_code, p.position_name, p.dept_id, r.id AS role_id, r.role_code, r.role_name FROM t_position p LEFT JOIN t_role r ON r.role_code = CASE p.position_code WHEN 'GENERAL_MANAGER' THEN 'GENERAL_MANAGER' WHEN 'HR_MANAGER' THEN 'HR_MANAGER' WHEN 'DEVELOPER' THEN 'RND_ENGINEER' WHEN 'SALES' THEN 'SALES_SPECIALIST' WHEN 'ACCOUNTANT' THEN 'ACCOUNTANT' END AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, p.id ASC
SELECT id, role_code, role_name, status, remark, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM t_role WHERE status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
